structs.name: CEntPlayerInfo
structs.size_evidence: no size method found. Replay max access end is 15 (IKHandBone[1] at +14). Bounds: lower 15 (Replay), upper 128 (the view sits in cpose_t's union at cpose+152, cpose is 280 in IDA, so the union cannot exceed 128; cpose size is A015's). Game-test size 16 is plausible but not proven by Replay. IDA size 104 has no Replay support.
structs.view: Replay reads this struct as the player view of cpose_t at cpose+152 (IDA cpose_t.actor offset) on the eType 1 / 0x11 path of CG_Pose_DoControllers@0x1416E2370. The same bytes are named CEntActorInfo there (A015 owns that).
members: CG_Pose_DoControllers@0x1416E2370: `*(_QWORD *)&controller->actor.pitch != 0` gates the call. BG_Pose_ApplyControllerBits@0x140CDF0D0: `v3 = *(float **)pose`, then reads v3[12..] (control+48 onward). BG_Pose_DoDogControllers@0x140CDF030: `v3 = *poseCtx; v8 = *(float *)(v3 + 48) * 0.008726646f`. Offset 48 is clientControllers_t.tag_origin_angles, so the pointer is clientControllers_t *.
BG_Pose_ApplyControllerBits@0x140CDF0D0: loop of 4 over `pose + 8` calls DObj_ApplyControllerBoneBit(dobj, bits, *v4, v5), v5 += 12 (clientControllers_t.angles[4])
CG_Pose_DoControllers@0x1416E2370: `LOBYTE(controller->actor.prevZ) == 2` picks BG_Pose_DoDogControllers, else BG_Pose_ApplyControllerBits. Byte +12 is the same byte as prevZ in CEntActorInfo.

BG_Pose_ApplyControllerBits@0x140CDF0D0: `*(pose + 13) != 0xFE` and `*(pose + 14) != 0xFE` gate DObj_ApplyLocalTagMask / DObjCompleteHierarchyBits for hand IK (v3[18..23] = hand_ik_local_pos). Replaces the IDA _padD range at +13.
changed_members: split: IKHandBone unsigned __int8[2] at +13 (proven above); the other 9 bytes stay pad
no Replay access on the player view; propose to remove or leave in pad (IDA guess)
CG_Pose_DoControllers, BG_Pose_DoDogControllers, BG_Pose_ApplyControllerBits read nothing at +15 and above
no Replay access; IDA guess, propose to remove
unconfirmed: ptr24 (IDA +24): no Replay access in the player-view paths read
size 16 (game-test) vs 104 (IDA): not proven either way; Replay evidence stops at 15
structs.notes: First-pass correction: the animCtrl citation (BG_AnimationState_DoControllers@0x1410E1710 `animState+12`) is wrong. Its caller passes the stack record filled by BG_AnimationState_InitBoneIndexCache@0x1410E20E0 (+0 treeHandle, +12 cacheMode), not a CEntPlayerInfo. The real animCtrl proof is the CG_Pose_DoControllers line above. BG_Pose_DoDogControllers's first parameter (poseCtx) is therefore a shared shape: qword at +0, byte at +12. Its prototype (`__int64 *`) does not say which struct it is; a prototype change is the coordinator's call. The union at cpose_t+152 (game-test +0xA0 union: actor/player/turret/vehicle/scriptMover/coverWall/fx) is not typed in IDA; cpose_t.actor is one member only. Propose to the cpose_t owner (A015) a union, not a change in this struct.

structs.name: CEntTurretInfo
structs.size_evidence: no size method found. Replay proves the members up to +60 (visualPitchLimitBottom at +56, 4 bytes), lower bound 60. Upper bound 128 from the cpose_t union (cpose 280 minus union start 152; the vehicle view is 128 in game-test and is the largest union member). Game-test size 80 and IDA 80 are not proven. The first pass's note (not shaped like CEntTurretInfo) was wrong: the turret view is at centity+152.
structs.view: CG_Entity_TurretPreControllers@0x1416AA750 is called with the centity (a3) from CG_EntityMP_ProcessTurretEntity@0x1417851D0, so a3+152 is the turret view. CG_Entity_AdjustVehicleTurretAngles@0x1416A6440 receives the same centity as turretEntity: it reads turretEntity+64 (cpose.angles) and writes turretEntity+152 (vec3) and +176 (bool).
members: CG_Entity_AdjustVehicleTurretAngles@0x1416A6440: `AxisToAngles(outAxis, turretEntity + 152)` writes 3 floats (pitch, yaw, barrelPitch). Union warning: CG_Entity_TurretPreControllers@0x1416AA750 stores `*(_QWORD *)(a3 + 152) = &viewangles` (a vec3_t * pointer) before the AdjustVehicle call, so +0 also holds a pointer on that path (game-test union {vec3_t *viewAngles; CEntTurretAngles angles; vec3_t onVehicleGunAngles}).

structs.name: CEntVehicleInfo
structs.size_evidence: no size method found. Replay's last proven byte is spinWheelBones at +124 (CG_Vehicle_UpdateWheelPoses@0x1417045B0 writes `*(entity + 276)`), lower bound 125. Upper bound 128 from the cpose_t union (cpose 280 minus 152; vehicle is the largest union member in game-test at 128). IDA and game-test both say 128, not proven by Replay.
structs.view: The view is cpose_t+152 (centity+152), the vehicle member of the game-test +0xA0 union. Replay reads it as a union of per-vehicle-type layouts: a wheeled-car layout (+24 wheelFraction .. +124 spinWheelBones) and a helicopter layout (+42/43, +46..53 stick/pedal/lever bones, +104..117 rotor blade bones). A flat struct is wrong for helicopters; the car layout is what IDA's flat struct matches.

propose a union of the car layout (wheelFraction / wheelBoneIndex / wheelSteeringRatio* / wheelSpinAngle / treadAnimInfo) and the helicopter layout (rotor / tail / stick / pedal bones). Helicopter bones at +42/+43 and +46..+53 overlap wheelFraction and wheelBoneIndex. Union edit: proposal only.

tag_turretLeft / tag_turretRight (+24/+25) and terrainMode / gunTrackMode / advancedRotor / rotor angles (+24..+104): helicopter and terrain union members, not checked individually
steerYaw / Ackermann are CONFIRMED above; no further evidence needed

structs.notes: The IDA flat struct matches the wheeled-car path for +0..+68, +92 and +124, and matches UpdateBoneControllersInternal for +8, +10, +20, +120..+123 and the helicopter rotor indices at +104..+117 (partly). It cannot be right for both paths at once: +24..+52 and +104 mean different things per vehicle type. The size question needs a union decision by the owner. A015 owns cpose_t, which decides where this view sits and how big the union is.
